summary: Shelf Keeper: Track your personal book collection and who has borrowed what, so you always know where your books are.
implemented_features: Add a book to the collection
View all books in one list
Filter to books currently lent out
See how many books are lent out
assumptions: Built for A single user managing their home library on their own computer..
Persistence decision: Browser localStorage with malformed-data recovery; single key holding the Book array.
